استبشروا (form X)
# اِسْتَبْشَرُوا (istabšarū) /is.tab.ʃa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَبْشَرَ (istabšara)
# اِسْتَبْشِرُوا (istabširū) /is.tab.ʃi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَبْشَرَ (istabšara)
